arecue has been playing UHC since the pre-historic times... long before Season 1 was ever written down. It's no surprise then that arecue has racked up his fair share of kills. arecue is recognized as one of the most adept players in UHC. He has participated in all but two seasons to date and has proven his grit in each and every one. Many of his wins are nailbiters; they come down to epic conclusions where the victor comes out with only a few hearts. Although, there are notable exceptions; in Season 11, arecue set the record for the highest number of kills in a single game (7 kills), which has yet to be passed and only tied once by Karova.
What truly makes arecue so deadly is his knowledge. arecue stays well read on updates as well as more obscure nuggets of information to gain a competitive edge over his opponents. Combine that with his aptitude for coming up with unique solutions for dealing with enemy players, and you have yourself a consistent threat on your hands.
While often overlooked due to the two dominant powers in the field, arecue is tied for third in total Ironmen. While that could be thanks to the vast number of seasons he has played in, arecue consistently remains competitive for Ironman and likely would have gotten more if it were not for his aggressive playstyle. Moreover, arecue in his many seasons has only died one time to PvE causes and that was from a split-second error in placing a Nether Portal beyond the World Border. arecue also produced a video with Enzo_ showcasing his repertoire of tactics he uses to dispense of mobs in UHC.
So be warned, dear reader! Should you come across this man in a UHC, he very well may do any of the following: jump you in your spawn base, storm into your mine, shoot you up with fireworks, fight you in a boat, snipe you from afar, or lure you into a trap! You've been warned.

Caenum_ is the guy who got this whole operation rolling. Had it not been for his recording of S1, none of this may have ever happened. He made the push to start recording these games, and with it came a series of games that has now stretched over half of a decade.
In UHC circles, Caenum_ is recognized for a few specific things: ironmen, strip-mining, and jukeboxes. Caenum_, ever since the early days, has been a tough-out for the title of Ironman. Now the sole holder of most ironmen, Caenum_ has achieved 10 in five less games played than his closest competitor, Enzo_; part of his acclaim comes from his infamous nature as a strip-miner -- a method that, while looked down upon, cannot be refuted as ineffective or viewed as exclusive to Caenum_. Something Caenum_ has also received great notoriety for is his seemingly uncanny aptitude to always remember to make jukeboxes -- mind you, those things cost a diamond. Nevertheless, Caenum_, more so than any other player, commits to making jukeboxes, which just gives a glimpse into his quirky sense of humor.
Not to be overlooked, Caenum_ holds his own in PVP. Across his career, he has slain 12 players, which places him in 6th overall. This shouldn't come as a surprise if you've watched some of his recordings, in which his team usually delivers crushing defeats to enemy teams -- S1, S14, S17, S26, S27, S30, but in losses, often provides a close finish with the enemy team -- S3, S4, S13, S26.
In seasons where players must find their teammates, Caenum_ struggles to do so. In Season 10, he was absent from the rest of his team for the final fight. In Season 14, he only found a teammate minutes before the final fight. In Season 17 and 26, he spent much of the game without his team. In Seasons 15 and 28, he never found a teammate. It's hard to say why Caenum_ has such misfortune in this category -- perhaps his defensive playstyle is to blame. Regardless, his tactics do often warrant him victories as he is one of the winningest players in UHC. Lastly, Caenum_ achieved what no player has (or likely ever will again): Win the game without taking damage. This was dubbed the "Perfect Ironman" and was Caenum_'s tenth ironman earned. His showcase further cemented himself as one of the great defensive stalwarts in UHC history.

Ahh, the speedrunner! Yep, that's coleam! He excels at doing things as fast as possible... even if he does take a little fall damage along the way. With how fast he accomplishes things in UHC, it's no surprise that he's taken up speedrunning as a hobby. In most games, he's built a portal before the thought has even crossed most peoples' minds. Coleam ability to quickly gather resources only accentuates his ability in combat. Historically not a ranged combat kind of guy, coleam's skill with a bow (and crossbow) has noticeably improved, which further advances his tour de force status in UHC.
When coleam wins, he wins big; he posted big kill numbers in his victories during Seasons 8, 14, 17, and 28. It comes as no surprise of course when one finds out he has gotten "Most Kills in a Season" the most times, the Crown the most times, drawn 'First Blood' the most times, and has the third longest killstreak of all time.
Coleam plays aggressively. He doesn't usually take a moment to think before he charges in, but that doesn't mean he's not smart about how he plays. He's usually planned out his game progression so well that there is little for him to worry about.

OyGod is an underdog. No moment better defines this than his shocking upset of Karova in Season 15. Still considered by all as one of the greatest -- if not the greatest -- fight in UHC history. The triumphant victory over a seemingly unstoppable enemy made the fight legendary in the eyes of many. For those who watched, his victory was akin to that of David's over Goliath.
OyGod has remained an underdog since then too, but that hasn't stopped him. In Seasons 16, 17, 22, 25, 27, and 30, his team has placed second. Many wins just within arms reach. That being said, OyGod has also had his fair share of heartbreaking defeats -- as underdogs do; to name them: seasons 21, 26, and 28.
Besides giving us one of the greatest moments in UHC, OyGod has pushed the game forward into a new and better age. By his own design, OyGod developed a datapack to facilitate and automate key and tedious parts of the UHC gamemode. Starting with Season 26, OyGod's datapack has made games more fluid and enjoyable for all parties involved. His willingness to continue development has been crucial in the wonderful evolution of this gamemode.
OyGod has also lended his hand in the creation of a UHC intro -- Season 21 --, which goes to show how diverse his skillset is.
OyGod remains a sought after teammate for his ability to work with teammates and his overall level-headed attitude in games. His seemingly jack-of-all-trades nature in UHC makes him both a formidable opponent in both combat as well as the race for ironman. Do not underestimate this underdog; for your folly will be your last.

Enzo_: One of the greats! He has taken part in every UHC other than the first and the "Underdog Season 32". Throughout his career, he has amassed over 30 kills, 10 Ironmans, 9 victories, 2 team wipes, and 1 First Blood. His playstyle is a deadly mix of defense and aggression, balancing his combat strategy depending on the situation. Known for his skill with a bow, Enzo_ has over 10 ranged kills, meaning he kills 1/3 of his enemies with a bow or crossbow!

If you try to outlast Enzo_ in order to gain victory over him, you'll be sorely disappointed. With 10 Ironman victories under his belt and a slew of final fight appearances, you can bet he'll be waiting for you at 0 0.

A veteran of the gamestyle, Enzo_ has tried his hand at content creation multiple times. He's made UHC intro videos, UHC episodes, and UHC gameplay guides.

Enzo_'s experience and skill combines into a deadly tornado of virtual vengeance. Godspeed, those who stand in his way!
